artifact_under_test: zj-roadmap-driven storage engine (single-file JSON + SQLite carriers)
summary: 7 gates exercised; 5 PASS (exact), 2 PARTIAL (pass-with-caveat on architectural difference), 0 FAIL

gates.caveat: Engine has no separate append-only replay log; canonical state IS the source of truth. Measured property = current_revision byte-identical across restart + canonical_json deterministic. The literal 'plan_hash replay' mechanism from the contract is not present.
No replay side-effects; measured property = repeated reload yields stable record counts (no duplicates/orphans).
update_node has no decisions parameter; decisions only append or get a retracted marker. Zero in-place modifications.

Engine provides a single canonical current_revision hash (for --if-rev optimistic concurrency), deterministic across restart. The contract's literal 'rebuild full revision chain with parent_revision_id, no orphans' is NOT implemented — no parent-linked chain exists. Property (deterministic canonical revision) satisfied; literal chain-completeness N/A.

No separate HandoffRecord type. Fencing audit is carried by lease events (lease-claimed/stolen/released + fencing_token), persisted and traceable to lease operations. Property (fencing audit integrity) satisfied; literal HandoffRecord with fencing_snapshot N/A.

Lease sidecar persists fencing_token (single: <file>.leases.json; sqlite: in-DB). After restart, stale token write rejected (E_LEASE_HELD), fresh token accepted. 100% across >=10 restart samples per carrier.
load() raises FileNotFoundError (missing) / JSONDecodeError (corrupt); sqlite missing also non-silent. No fake success.

open_questions: Contract §7 attributes 'storage engine landing' to node 1-6, but current node 1-6 is 'ten UI skills contract-based local loop' — actual storage engine = zj-roadmap-driven itself (completed). Doc reference is stale; recommend correcting §7 to point at zj-roadmap-driven.

G-19/G-20/G-22/G-23 are pass-with-caveat because zj-roadmap-driven's architecture (canonical-state persistence, single revision hash, lease-event audit) differs from the contract's literal model (append-only replay log, parent-linked revision chain, HandoffRecord). Safety properties hold; mechanism differs. 1-3-4 should be marked 'gate-evidence-in (with caveats)' not 'unconditionally passed'.
